As of **June 2024**, **Dell Technologies** does **not offer servers pre-configured with NVIDIA A40 GPUs** in their standard PowerEdge lineup. Here is a detailed summary:

### Dell PowerEdge & NVIDIA A40

- Dell currently lists several **NVIDIA GPUs** (such as A100, A30, L40, T4, and RTX models) as options on various PowerEdge servers.
- **The NVIDIA A40 does not appear as a selectable GPU** for any Dell PowerEdge system on their official configurators or product specification sheets.
- The Dell servers most often paired with high-end GPUs (like the R750xa, XE9680, or XE8545) also do **not list the A40 as compatible** in official documentation.

### Industry Context

- The **NVIDIA A40** is an enterprise/datacenter GPU based on Ampere architecture, designed for graphics, virtualization, and CUDA workloads.
- **Some third-party resellers or system integrators** (not Dell direct) may offer PowerEdge servers with A40s installed as a custom SKU, but this is not an official, supported option from Dell themselves.

### Official Dell References
- [Dell GPU compatibility guide (pdf)](https://www.dell.com/support/manuals/en-us/poweredge-r750/pwredge_gpu_ug/qualified-nvidia-gpus-%E2%80%93-compute?guid=guid-edeebe90-28b7-4baa-acaa-893bcad176af&lang=en-us) (as of April 2024, the A40 is **not listed**.)
- [Dell PowerEdge GPU offerings](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/poweredge-servers/sr/servers/poweredge-gpu-servers) only list A16, A30, A100, L40, T4, and RTX models.

### Summary Table

| Dell Server        | Official A40 Option |
|--------------------|---------------------|
| R740/R750          | No                  |
| R750xa             | No                  |
| XE8545/XE9680      | No                  |

---

**If you specifically need Dell servers with NVIDIA A40 GPUs, you will likely need to:**
- Source the A40 GPUs separately and install them yourself (at your own risk, and be aware of power/cooling/BIOS support limitations).
- Work with a third-party system integrator for a custom solution (not directly supported by Dell).

**For officially supported options**, consider Dell servers with NVIDIA A16, A30, A100, or L40 instead.
